HERO_SUBTITLE: Learn French with pleasure in an online format
HERO_DESCRIPTION: Interactive group lessons via Zoom with experienced teachers. We offer courses for all levels: from beginners to advanced.
ABOUT_DESC: La Classe is an online language school specializing in teaching French. We conduct interactive lessons via Zoom where students can practice conversational skills, learn grammar, and immerse themselves in French culture.
LEVELS_DESC: We offer courses for all proficiency levels
LEVEL_A1_DESC: For those starting to learn French. Basic vocabulary, simple phrases, and foundations of grammar.
LEVEL_A2_DESC: Development of conversational skills, expanding vocabulary, working on grammar and comprehension.
SCHEDULE_DESC: All classes are held online via Zoom
SCHEDULE_A1: A1 Level - Sundays at 10:00 AM (Paris time)
SCHEDULE_A2: A2/B1 Level - Saturdays at 10:00 AM (Paris time)
TEACHER_DESC: Professional French teacher with extensive experience. I conduct lessons with love for the language and an individual approach to each student. Join us to learn French with pleasure!
TEACHER_QUOTE: Learning French should be enjoyable and engaging!
FORMAT_ITEM_2: Conversational practice with a native speaker
FORMAT_ITEM_3: Grammar explained in an accessible way
FORMAT_ITEM_4: Cultural insights and interesting facts about France
FORMAT_ITEM_5: All materials provided after each lesson
WHY_US_1_DESC: We create a comfortable environment where everyone can express themselves freely
WHY_US_2_DESC: We use modern teaching techniques that have proven effective
WHY_US_3_DESC: Our Telegram channel with useful materials and practice opportunities
CTA_DESC: Join our Telegram channel and sign up for your first lesson!
CONTACT_DESC: Write to us on Telegram to book a lesson or get more information
